Players Committee card image of [[Azure Angel (ALT)]] (original printing), game text: “May add one pilot and one astromech. During battle, if Anakin or R2-D2 aboard, may lose 1 Force to cancel a non-[Immune to Sense] interrupt. While Anakin or R2-D2 aboard, immune to attrition < 5 (< 6 if both).”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/azureangel_ai.png</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/91ca80c51880e683322c125b7a0b6ec807df1ab8 91ca80c] (18 February 2021). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
